title: Marlboro M hoax
intro: The Marlboro M Hoax was a false rumor originating from satire news website Abril Uno in January 2014 and republished in March 2015 It was an April Fools prank.

title: Mars hoax email
sd: Hoax claim about visibility of the planet Mars
intro: A hoax circulated by email in 2003 claimed that Mars would look as large as the full Moon to the naked eye on August 27 of that year The hoax has since resurfaced each time before Mars is at its closest to Earth, about every 26 months

title: Melanin theory
